exceptions.src/main.asm: Composition root: revision selection, iNES header, and one include per subsystem source.
exceptions.src/audio/data.asm: The complete shared audio bank is kept intact so stream labels and pointer-locality remain reviewable.
exceptions.src/data/enemies/tables.asm: Two compact fixed-size enemy tables are isolated from executable behavior and generated records.
exceptions.src/data/objects/animations.asm: Collision dispatch pointers and the complete animation bank form one stable data owner slightly above the preferred range.
exceptions.src/data/rooms/metadata.asm: Small room lifecycle tables occupy separate ROM segments but share one compact metadata owner.
exceptions.src/game/scoring.asm: The complete number formatting, score addition, and auxiliary-effect service is only 82 lines.
exceptions.src/game/timer/runtime.asm: The complete timer subsystem falls just below the preferred range and has no related code worth importing.
exceptions.src/game/transitions/orbit.asm: The complete room-entry orbit and sine lookup service is intrinsically compact.
exceptions.src/graphics/chr.asm: Generated CHR remains a deliberately tiny incbin boundary and is never stored in Git.
exceptions.src/graphics/hud/runtime.asm: All three gameplay HUD producers fit in one compact rendering module.
